_doc: DeepLabCut-Live head preview settings (docs/decisions/0224). python = the dlclivegui env's interpreter (the helper runs there, not in drieu_t_maze); model_path is relative to host/ unless absolute; port is on 127.0.0.1 only; cpu_threads caps the helper's CPU threads (2 measured best: faster model and less load on the tracker than the default). When the tracker has no centre of mass: hold_s = seconds to keep cropping around the last good one, then roi_fallback = crop the ROI's bounding box (~12 answers/s instead of 25; docs/decisions/0225).
